question: What was the average claim cost at each Miami repair shop in 2025?

report.interpretation: Average claim cost is incurred (paid plus open reserve) divided by claim count. I used claims with a 2025 loss date (2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31) at the two repair shops in the Miami metro. Only auto collision, glass and hail claims carry a repair shop.
report.answer: Franco Auto Repair (RS-013, preferred) averaged about $4,459 per claim across 88 claims in 2025. Patton Body Works (RS-016, non-preferred) averaged about $3,311 across 53 claims. Franco is about $1,148 higher per claim, even though it is in the preferred network. I didn't investigate why, and this is not a finding of wrongdoing.
report.answer_sql: WITH pay AS (SELECT claim_id, sum(amount) paid FROM claim_payments GROUP BY claim_id) SELECT c.repair_shop_id, rs.name, count(*) AS claims, sum(coalesce(paid,0)+c.reserve_amount)/count(*) AS avg_claim_cost FROM claims c JOIN repair_shops rs USING(repair_shop_id) LEFT JOIN pay USING(claim_id) WHERE c.loss_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' AND rs.metro='Miami' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

WITH source AS (
    SELECT c.*, p.channel, p.metro,
           coalesce(pay.paid, 0) AS paid_to_date,
           coalesce(pay.paid, 0) + c.reserve_amount AS incurred,
           c.close_date - c.report_date AS days_to_close
    FROM claims c
    JOIN policies p USING (policy_id)
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT claim_id, sum(amount) AS paid FROM claim_payments GROUP BY claim_id
    ) pay USING (claim_id)
)
SELECT repair_shop_id, sum(incurred) / count(*) AS value
FROM source
WHERE loss_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND loss_date <= DATE '2025-12-31'
  AND repair_shop_id IN ('RS-013', 'RS-016')
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY ALL
